blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A migration moves a working integration from Claude Opus 4.6 to Claude Sonnet 5.5 on the Claude API. What changes in the tools array?

options.text: The old entry stays, and the new model accepts it unchanged
options.says: Ruled out because "Claude 5.5 and later models support computer use only through this toolset", so the old entry does not carry over.

options.text: A single entry replaces the earlier definition, with no beta header
options.says: The first page says "Claude 5.5 and later models support computer use only through this toolset" and that "The request needs no beta header."

options.text: A beta header is added so that the new toolset can be enabled
options.says: Ruled out because "The request needs no beta header."

options.text: The entry gains width and height fields that match the screen
options.says: Ruled out because the entry rejects the display fields, and "coordinates are always in the pixel space of the screenshots you return".

questions.stem: A payment form appears in the middle of a batch that the app has already started. Where must the check by a person sit?

options.text: Before each block runs, one by one
options.says: The first page says that "a batch can finish a multistep action inside one turn", so the check goes before each block runs.

options.text: When the user's request arrives at the app
options.says: Ruled out because the check belongs "before each block runs, not once per reply and not at the start of the task".

options.text: After the whole batch has finished running
options.says: Ruled out because the page says to "make that check before each block runs", and a check after the batch comes too late.

options.text: In the classifier layer, instead of a person
options.says: Ruled out because the classifier layer is a second one: "That layer is not a replacement".

questions.stem: An application sizes screenshots with the rule of the practice, on a model of the high-resolution tier. What is the effect?

options.text: Detail that the larger budget would allow is lost
options.says: The first page says the rule of the practice is "safe on every model", and "it costs detail on a high-resolution model".

options.text: Coordinates from Claude must be multiplied instead of divided
options.says: Ruled out because "scale Claude's coordinates back up before applying them to the real display" holds for any scale.

options.text: Requests without a beta header fail
options.says: Ruled out because "The request needs no beta header."

options.text: The API rejects screenshots below a minimum size
options.says: Ruled out because the rule "is safe on every model", and the page names no minimum size.

origin.section: Screenshots must fit, and coordinates are theirs

questions.stem: A compliance team asks where the screenshots from a computer use session are kept. What is the documented answer?

options.text: In a vault that Anthropic holds for each session
options.says: Ruled out because "Anthropic processes the images and action requests in real time as part of the API call".

options.text: In the Files API, where the workspace can read them
options.says: Ruled out because "Computer use is a client-side tool."

options.text: In an environment that the customer controls
options.says: The second page quotes the documentation: "All screenshots, mouse actions, keyboard inputs, and any files involved in a session are captured and stored in your environment, not by Anthropic."

options.text: Nowhere, since they are deleted once Claude answers
options.says: Ruled out because the documentation says "Always carefully review and verify Claude's computer use actions and logs", which needs logs to exist.
